# FieldSize

`Flare.Components.FieldSize`

Size of a form field control (input, select, multi-select). Medium is the default.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small - dense, for toolbars and inline filters. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small - compact. |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium - default field size. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large. |
